scope: One captured Native symbolic source and its supplied 56-name substitution. Raw EOF, whole-source types, checked environment and replacement contract are kernel checked. The same ground source inputs have three strict native Ceil results: normal Top, NUMBER zero Bottom, and the same zero assignment with only the number lower condition removed Top. The full checked source yields amount 1 and timestamp 1700000000.
identityBoundary: Existing Solidity, ABI, runtime and product model bytes are preserved. The strict native results use the pinned existing K baseline with assumeDefined=false. Native validity is not introduced as a HOL axiom.
reproductionBoundary: Full mode rehashes retained saved artifacts, database source, oracle guards, heap lineage and current kernel input snapshots. Metadata-only mode checks the immutable public record and current product bindings. Neither mode is a fresh kernel replay or independent Assurance. The retained artifact bundle and locator are required for full mode.
